papers.title: Accelerating posterior sampling in Bayesian inverse problems with diffusion models: an online-offline perspective
papers.translated_title: 加速贝叶斯逆问题中基于扩散模型的后验采样：在线-离线视角
papers.author: Duc-Lam Duong
papers.summary: Bayesian inverse problems require both informative prior models and computationally feasible posterior inference. Score-based diffusion models provide expressive learned priors, but their use for inversion introduces a conditioning problem: the score of a noised posterior is generally unavailable from a prior score alone. This selective survey reviews the principal approaches to that problem, including likelihood guidance, spectral and projection methods, sequential Monte Carlo corrections, and amortized conditional training. We organize methods by how they split cost between offline preparation and online inference, and compare their assumptions, advantages and limitations, with emphasis on computational speedups. Some ongoing directions and open questions are gathered at the end.
papers.translated_summary: 贝叶斯反问题既需要信息丰富的先验模型，也需要计算上可行的后验推断。基于分数的扩散模型提供了富有表现力的学习先验，但将其用于反演会引入一个条件化问题：含噪后验的分数通常无法仅由先验分数获得。本选择性综述回顾了解决该问题的主要方法，包括似然引导、谱方法与投影方法、序贯蒙特卡洛校正以及摊销条件训练。我们按照方法如何在离线准备与在线推断之间分配成本来组织这些方法，并比较它们的假设、优势与局限，重点在于计算加速。文末汇集了一些进行中的方向和开放问题。

papers.title: Best-of-Both-Worlds FTRL for Linear Bandits: The Interplay of Information Acquisition, Corruption, and Geometry
papers.translated_title: 线性赌博机的最优双世界FTRL：信息获取、腐化与几何的相互作用
papers.author: Canzhe Zhao
papers.summary: We study \textit{best-of-both-worlds} (BOBW) algorithms for linear bandits, which aim to simultaneously guarantee $\gO(\sqrt T)$ regret in the adversarial regime and $\gO(\log T)$ regret in the stochastic regime over $T$ rounds. For finite action sets, we introduce \emph{information-acquisition follow-the-regularized-leader} (\IAFTRL{}), the first BOBW algorithm based purely on the follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL) framework that attains an $\gO(\cstar\log T)$-type regret in the stochastic regime, where $\cstar$ is the information-acquisition complexity that characterizes instance-dependent optimality in linear bandits, while retaining the $\gO(\sqrt{T})$ regret guarantee in the adversarial regime. This resolves the open problem posed in~\cite{LeeEtAl2021,KongZ023,ItoT23,ZhaoItoLi2025}.
papers.translated_summary: 我们研究线性赌博机的最优双世界（BOBW）算法，其目标是在T轮中同时保证对抗性情形下的$\gO(\sqrt T)$遗憾和随机性情形下的$\gO(\log T)$遗憾。对于有限动作集，我们引入信息获取跟随正则化领导者（IAFTRL），这是首个完全基于跟随正则化领导者（FTRL）框架的BOBW算法，在随机性情形下达到$\gO(\cstar\log T)$型遗憾，其中$\cstar$是信息获取复杂度，刻画了线性赌博机中依赖于实例的最优性，同时在对抗性情形下保持$\gO(\sqrt{T})$遗憾保证。这解决了文献\cite{LeeEtAl2021,KongZ023,ItoT23,ZhaoItoLi2025}中提出的开放问题。

papers.title: [Re] Pure Noise to the Rescue of Insufficient Data
papers.translated_title: 纯噪声拯救数据不足
papers.author: Seungjae Ryan Lee
papers.summary: We examine the main claims of Zada, Benou, and Irani (2021), which states that in an image classification task with imbalanced training data, (i) using pure noise to augment minority-class images encourages generalization by improving minority-class accuracy. This method is paired with (ii) a new batch normalization layer that normalizes noise images using affine parameters learned from natural images, which improves the model's performance. Moreover, (iii) this improvement is robust to varying levels of data augmentation. Finally, the authors propose that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification even on balanced training data. We implemented the training pipeline from the description of the paper using PyTorch and integrated authors' code snippets for sampling pure noise images and batch normalizing noise and natural images separately. We reproduced the main claims that (i) oversampling with pure noise improves generalization by improving the minority-class accuracy, (ii) the proposed batch normalization (BN) method outperforms baselines, (iii) and this improvement is robust across data augmentations. Our results also support that (iv) adding pure noise images can improve classification on balanced training data. However, additional experiments suggest that the performance improvement from OPeN may be more orthogonal to the improvement caused by a bigger network or more complex data augmentation.
papers.translated_summary: 我们考察Zada、Benou和Irani（2021）的主要主张，该文指出，在训练数据不平衡的图像分类任务中，（i）使用纯噪声增强少数类图像，通过提高少数类准确率来促进泛化。该方法与（ii）一种新的批归一化层相结合，该层使用从自然图像学到的仿射参数对噪声图像进行归一化，从而提升模型性能。此外，（iii）这种改进对不同水平的数据增强具有鲁棒性。最后，作者提出（iv）添加纯噪声图像甚至可以在平衡训练数据上改善分类。我们根据论文描述使用PyTorch实现了训练流程，并整合了作者用于采样纯噪声图像以及分别对噪声和自然图像进行批归一化的代码片段。我们复现了主要主张：（i）使用纯噪声进行过采样通过提高少数类准确率来改善泛化，（ii）所提出的批归一化（BN）方法优于基线，（iii）且这种改进在不同数据增强下具有鲁棒性。我们的结果也支持（iv）添加纯噪声图像可以在平衡训练数据上改善分类。然而，额外实验表明，OPeN带来的性能提升可能与更大网络或更复杂数据增强所带来的提升更为正交。

papers.title: Character-Name Concentration in LLM Fiction: Measuring Displacement and Mitigating Repetition
papers.translated_title: LLM小说中角色名称集中度：测量位移与缓解重复
papers.author: Alejandro Mozo Quesada
papers.summary: Character names in large language model (LLM) fiction concentrate on a handful of recurrent names such as 'Elara' and 'Elias', a measurable face of AI slop. Existing fixes either require logit access or retraining, or operate per request and cannot control concentration across a corpus. How much prompt-level strategies reduce concentration, and at what cost to name naturalness, has not been systematically measured. We present an empirical study of name-concentration control across eight strategies and introduce speculative naming, a fine-tuning-free method that adapts the draft-verify-reject paradigm of speculative decoding from tokens to names. The method requests candidate name-sets through verbalized sampling, scores them against a SlopTracker that combines a per-model fingerprint with a runtime counter, and selects through a temperature-controlled rule or its strict variant (HARD). We use 20 LLMs to generate 44,782 stories in four languages from text and visual stimuli (88,919 named characters), and measure concentration with a list-free collision metric (Slop Ratio, SR) decomposed into known and emergent components. List-based strategies do not remove slop: static banlists displace concentration to emergent names and more than halve the share of attested real names. Speculative naming removes it: the sampling scaffold alone cuts SR by 89% on average, the dynamic tracker brings the total reduction to 95%, mean collision probability falls from 7.3% to 0.4%, and known-name collisions hold at zero while naturalness stays close to baseline (42-69% attested by language) and within-story collisions drop from 4.3% to 0.2%. The strategy ranking is stable across languages, model families, and name-counting conventions. Name concentration is thus controllable at the corpus level without logit access or retraining; broader creative diversity beyond naming remains open.
papers.translated_summary: 大语言模型小说中的人物名字集中在少数反复出现的名字上，如“Elara”和“Elias”，这是AI生成劣质内容的一个可测量表征。现有修复方法要么需要logit访问权限或重新训练，要么按请求逐一操作而无法控制整个语料库中的集中度。提示层面的策略能在多大程度上降低集中度，以及对名字自然度造成何种代价，尚未得到系统测量。我们提出一项跨八种策略的名字集中度控制实证研究，并引入推测性命名——一种无需微调的方法，将推测性解码的草稿-验证-拒绝范式从token适配到名字。该方法通过言语化采样请求候选名字集，对照一个结合了每模型指纹与运行时计数器的SlopTracker进行评分，并通过温度控制规则或其严格变体（HARD）进行选择。我们使用20个大语言模型，从文本和视觉刺激生成四种语言的44,782篇故事（88,919个具名角色），并用无列表碰撞指标（Slop Ratio，SR）测量集中度，将其分解为已知成分和涌现成分。基于列表的策略无法消除劣质内容：静态禁用列表将集中度转移至涌现名字，并使已证实的真实名字占比减少一半以上。推测性命名则能消除它：仅采样脚手架平均将SR降低89%，动态追踪器使总降幅达到95%，平均碰撞概率从7.3%降至0.4%，已知名字碰撞保持为零，同时自然度接近基线（按语言42-69%已证实），故事内碰撞从4.3%降至0.2%。该策略排名在语言、模型家族和名字计数惯例之间保持稳定。因此，名字集中度可在语料库层面控制，无需logit访问或重新训练；命名之外的更广泛创意多样性仍有待探索。

papers.title: DriftingPlanner: Drifting Generative Models for One-Step Trajectory Planning in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.translated_title: DriftingPlanner：面向端到端自动驾驶中一步轨迹规划的漂移生成模型
papers.author: Ziming Liu
papers.summary: End-to-end planners decode the ego trajectory either by coordinate regression, which is fast but blends plausible maneuvers into one trajectory that may follow none of them, or by diffusion and flow matching, which model the trajectory distribution but need several inference steps. Drifting models move this iteration into training: a one-step generator learns to follow an attraction--repulsion field between generated and ground-truth samples. Drifting was developed for class-conditional image generation, where every class supplies many positive samples. In planning, every scene is its own condition. Pooling scenes would attract the generated trajectories of one scene to the ground truth of unrelated scenes, whereas computing the field per scene leaves a single positive, the expert trajectory. Mutual repulsion then holds the generated trajectories on a shell around it, so any single generated trajectory deviates from the ground truth. We present DriftingPlanner, a trajectory planner trained with the drifting loss alone, without any coordinate regression term. It computes the field per scene and removes the shell at inference: it decodes every noise vector together with its negation in one batched pass, and averaging each antithetic pair cancels the linear part of the displacement from the shell center. On NAVSIM navtest, DriftingPlanner reaches a state-of-the-art 93.75 PDMS, and with single-step inference its drifting decoder comes within 0.13 PDMS of the best diffusion or flow matching setting, which needs ten inference steps.
papers.translated_summary: 端到端规划器通过坐标回归或扩散与流匹配来解码自车轨迹。坐标回归速度快，但会将可能的机动混合成一条可能不遵循任何机动的轨迹；扩散与流匹配则对轨迹分布建模，但需要多次推理步骤。漂移模型将这一迭代过程移入训练阶段：一步生成器学习在生成样本与真实样本之间遵循吸引—排斥场。漂移方法最初为类别条件图像生成而提出，其中每个类别提供大量正样本。在规划中，每个场景本身就是自己的条件。将场景池化会使一个场景生成的轨迹被吸引到不相关场景的真实轨迹上，而按场景计算场则只留下一个正样本，即专家轨迹。相互排斥随后将生成的轨迹保持在其周围的一个壳层上，因此任何单条生成轨迹都会偏离真实轨迹。我们提出 DriftingPlanner，一种仅用漂移损失训练、不含任何坐标回归项的轨迹规划器。它按场景计算场，并在推理时移除壳层：在一次批处理中同时解码每个噪声向量及其相反向量，对每个对偶对取平均可抵消来自壳层中心的位移的线性部分。在 NAVSIM navtest 上，DriftingPlanner 达到最先进的 93.75 PDMS，且在单步推理下，其漂移解码器与最佳扩散或流匹配设置仅差 0.13 PDMS，而后者需要十步推理。

papers.title: OntoDoc: Automatically Generating Ontology Resource Descriptions
papers.translated_title: OntoDoc：自动生成本体资源描述
papers.author: Juan Guajardo Gutierrez
papers.summary: Knowledge graphs and ontologies form the backbone of structured, machine-readable knowledge representation, yet ontology terms often lack natural language descriptions, limiting their accessibility and reuse. Existing ontology verbalization approaches tend to rely on rule-based or template-driven techniques that operate on strict, formal schema axioms, resulting in rigid verbalizations that fail to convey richer contextual semantics. We present OntoDoc, a multi-agent framework for automatically generating natural language descriptions for any Internationalized Resource Identifier (IRI) within a SPARQL endpoint or RDF file. OntoDoc operates through a four-stage pipeline: (1) a Database Context agent that adaptively explores the knowledge graph via SPARQL to collect semantically informative triples about the target IRI; (2) a Web Context agent that retrieves and re-ranks encyclopedic background knowledge from Wikipedia and the open web; (3) an Assumption Generation agent that synthesizes both contexts into a structured, evidence-grounded list of intermediate assumptions; and (4) a Description Generation agent that produces the final natural language description from the grounded assumptions. We evaluate OntoDoc on three knowledge graphs spanning biomedical, agricultural, and cross-domain settings, using both automatic scoring via Large Language Models (LLMs) and human evaluation with 11 annotators. OntoDoc consistently matches or exceeds a naive LLM baseline and a template-based ontology verbalizer in accuracy. Furthermore, it vastly outperforms both baselines in the completeness of the generated descriptions, delivering an average 12% improvement in completeness over the naive baseline across all domains, and improving completeness scores by as much as 2.8 points on a 5-point scale relative to the ontology verbalizer.
papers.translated_summary: 知识图谱和本体构成了结构化、机器可读的知识表示 backbone，然而本体术语往往缺乏自然语言描述，限制了其可访问性和复用性。现有的本体语言化方法倾向于依赖基于规则或模板驱动的技术，这些技术作用于严格的形式化模式公理，导致语言化结果僵化，无法传达更丰富的上下文语义。我们提出 OntoDoc，一个多智能体框架，用于为 SPARQL 端点或 RDF 文件中的任意国际化资源标识符（IRI）自动生成自然语言描述。OntoDoc 通过四阶段流水线运行：（1）数据库上下文智能体，通过 SPARQL 自适应地探索知识图谱，以收集关于目标 IRI 的语义信息丰富的三元组；（2）网络上下文智能体，从 Wikipedia 和开放网络中检索并重排百科背景知识；（3）假设生成智能体，将两种上下文综合为结构化的、有证据支撑的中间假设列表；（4）描述生成智能体，从有依据的假设中生成最终的自然语言描述。我们在涵盖生物医学、农业和跨领域设置的三个知识图谱上评估 OntoDoc，使用通过大语言模型（LLM）进行的自动评分以及由 11 名标注者进行的人工评估。OntoDoc 在准确性上始终匹配或超过朴素 LLM 基线和基于模板的本体语言化器。此外，它在生成描述的完整性上大幅优于两个基线，在所有领域中相对于朴素基线平均提升 12% 的完整性，并且相对于本体语言化器在 5 分制上完整性分数提升高达 2.8 分。

papers.title: Geometry of Confabulation and Refusal in Small Language Models
papers.translated_title: 小语言模型中虚构与拒绝的几何结构
papers.author: Vladimir Kazei
papers.summary: Faced with an unanswerable question, small language models can either refuse or confabulate: confidently produce a wrong answer. Can the hidden state before the first generated token provide a clue? Can we flip confabulations into refusals? I introduce ConfabQA, a 784-item benchmark whose obscure-pre-cutoff category breaks the typical correctness/knowledge-cutoff confound and map the geometry of the hidden state with linear probes, a sparse autoencoder (SAE), and direct optimization of intervention directions. On Qwen3-1.7B and Gemma 2 2B the probe separates upcoming refusals from confabulations well beyond prompt features (+7.4/+16.3 pp); on Llama 3.2 3B the ConfabQA margin is within fold-to-fold spread, but a direct refusal probe on PopQA and TriviaQA recovers +18-25 pp. On Qwen I closely inspect three candidate directions for the refusal vector: probe-recovered, Qwen-Scope SAE feature, and directly optimized. Although the three directions are pairwise 50-81 degrees apart, a push at or below the state's own norm along any of them flips most confabulations into refusal openings dominated by the "As..." family. Forcing the opener without touching the hidden state yields the same one-in-three judged-refusal rate as any push. The opposite push collapses refusals mostly into confabulations, yet leaves originally correct answers intact, so the direction gates the opening speech act rather than the knowledge behind it. Confabulations do not resolve into a concentrated feature in a dictionary or a token signature on Qwen3-1.7B. Scoring every probe on the margin over the strongest of four prompt-feature baselines extracts the hidden state's own contribution. Correctness signal is model-dependent and portable only for Llama 3.2 3B: 81% of the probe's margin over test majority survives transfer between ConfabQA, PopQA, and TriviaQA. Benchmark, judge, and code are released.
papers.translated_summary: 面对一个无法回答的问题，小型语言模型要么拒绝回答，要么虚构：自信地给出错误答案。第一个生成 token 之前的隐藏状态能否提供线索？我们能否将虚构翻转为拒绝？我引入了 ConfabQA，一个包含 784 个条目的基准，其 obscure-pre-cutoff 类别打破了典型的正确性/知识截止混淆，并用线性探针、稀疏自编码器（SAE）以及干预方向的直接优化来刻画隐藏状态的几何结构。在 Qwen3-1.7B 和 Gemma 2 2B 上，探针将即将发生的拒绝与虚构区分开来，效果远超提示特征（+7.4/+16.3 个百分点）；在 Llama 3.2 3B 上，ConfabQA 的裕度在折间波动范围内，但在 PopQA 和 TriviaQA 上的直接拒绝探针恢复了 +18-25 个百分点。在 Qwen 上，我仔细检查了拒绝向量的三个候选方向：探针恢复的方向、Qwen-Scope SAE 特征以及直接优化的方向。尽管这三个方向两两相距 50-81 度，但沿其中任一方向以等于或低于状态自身范数的幅度推动，都能将大多数虚构翻转为以“As...”家族为主的拒绝开头。在不触及隐藏状态的情况下强制该开头，与任何推动产生相同的三分之一判定拒绝率。反向推动则将拒绝大多坍缩为虚构，但原本正确的答案保持不变，因此该方向门控的是开头言语行为，而非其背后的知识。在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，虚构并未在字典中解析为集中的特征或 token 签名。在四个提示特征基线中最强者的裕度上对每个探针评分，可提取隐藏状态自身的贡献。正确性信号依赖于模型，且仅对 Llama 3.2 3B 可移植：探针相对于测试多数类的裕度中有 81% 在 ConfabQA、PopQA 和 TriviaQA 之间的迁移中得以保留。基准、评判器和代码均已发布。

papers.title: Learning momenta for Hamiltonian-based models
papers.translated_title: 学习基于哈密顿量模型中的动量
papers.author: Ignacio Puiggros T.
papers.summary: There has been increasing interest in methodologies that incorporate physics priors into neural network architectures to enhance their modeling capabilities. Among these methodologies, Hamiltonian neural networks (HNNs) and their variants have gained considerable attention. These architectures explicitly encode Hamiltonian mechanics both in their structure and loss function, resulting in desirable properties and additional modeled information. A crucial limitation of HNNs is their reliance on data on the target system's generalized momenta. This severely hampers their applicability when the analytical form of the generalized momenta is unknown, which frequently is the case in real-world applications. The goal of the present work is to develop a general extension of Hamiltonian-based architectures that addresses this issue by simultaneously learning the system's generalized momenta, Hamiltonian structure, and dynamics from data. The proposed architecture learns the generalized momenta when their analytical form is unknown, and only (potentially non-sequential) data on the state and its derivatives is available. A dissipative mass-spring system, a double pendulum, and a rolling disk under nonholonomic constraints are considered as canonical examples to assess the performance of the proposed architecture.
papers.translated_summary: 将物理先验融入神经网络架构以增强其建模能力的方法日益受到关注。在这些方法中，哈密顿神经网络及其变体获得了相当多的关注。这些架构在结构和损失函数中显式地编码哈密顿力学，从而产生理想的性质和额外的建模信息。哈密顿神经网络的一个关键局限在于其依赖目标系统广义动量的数据。当广义动量的解析形式未知时，这严重阻碍了其适用性，而这在实际应用中经常出现。本工作的目标是开发一种基于哈密顿的架构的一般性扩展，通过同时从数据中学习系统的广义动量、哈密顿结构和动力学来解决这一问题。所提出的架构在广义动量的解析形式未知、且仅有关于状态及其导数（可能非序列）的数据时学习广义动量。以耗散质量-弹簧系统、双摆以及非完整约束下的滚动圆盘作为典型示例，评估所提出架构的性能。

papers.title: EZ-Ar-VC: Robust Arabic Voice Anonymization with Generalization across Dialects and Code-Switching
papers.translated_title: EZ-Ar-VC：面向方言与语码转换泛化的稳健阿拉伯语语音匿名化
papers.author: Injy Hamed
papers.summary: Voice conversion (VC) models can be used to anonymize speech data while preserving naturalness. Existing models, however, are mainly optimized for English and other high-resource languages, and they fail to generalize well to Arabic due to its distinct phonology. In this work, we comprehensively evaluate existing zero-shot VC systems for Arabic speech, identifying limitations in pronunciation preservation. We then train an Arabic-centric model based on EZ-VC on diverse Arabic speech, and demonstrate strong performance in intelligibility, naturalness, and pronunciation preservation, while maintaining high speaker dissimilarity. Through subjective evaluation, we further demonstrate its robustness to code-switching and cross-dialectal conversion, as well as its generalization to Arabic dialects with limited representation in the training data. Our findings highlight the limitations of zero-shot VC and the importance of target-language adaptation for robust voice anonymization.
papers.translated_summary: 语音转换（VC）模型可用于在保持自然度的同时匿名化语音数据。然而，现有模型主要针对英语和其他高资源语言进行优化，由于阿拉伯语独特的音系特征，这些模型难以很好地泛化到阿拉伯语。在本工作中，我们全面评估了现有的零样本VC系统在阿拉伯语语音上的表现，识别出其在发音保持方面的局限性。随后，我们在多样化的阿拉伯语语音上训练了一个基于EZ-VC的阿拉伯语中心模型，并展示了其在可懂度、自然度和发音保持方面的强劲性能，同时保持了较高的说话人差异性。通过主观评估，我们进一步证明了该模型对语码转换和跨方言转换的鲁棒性，以及其对训练数据中代表性有限的阿拉伯语方言的泛化能力。我们的发现凸显了零样本VC的局限性以及目标语言适配对于鲁棒语音匿名化的重要性。

papers.title: Toward Bounding Coding-Agent Autonomy in Software Maintenance: A Pilot Study of Boundary Contracts
papers.translated_title: 面向软件维护中编码智能体自主性的边界约束：边界契约的初步研究
papers.author: Heeyong Eun
papers.summary: As coding agents gain greater autonomy to modify software repositories, relevant context alone does not define their operational authority. An artifact may be relevant to a maintenance task while being inappropriate to edit; conversely, another artifact may be required even when it is not explicitly mentioned in the request. We explore Boundary Contracts, a machine-readable abstraction that makes task-specific artifact roles (editable, inspect-only, required, and protected) explicit before repository modification begins. We conduct a pilot study on 40 maintenance tasks from a real enterprise repository, comparing the same Codex-based coding agent with and without Boundary Contract information. The boundary-informed condition improves macro edit-selection F1 from 0.440 to 0.682, required-behavior coverage from 0.429 to 0.673, and the number of strictly acceptable patches from 9 of 40 to 18 of 40. To probe whether these gains are explained only by improved file localization, we additionally analyze 21 tasks in which both conditions modify at least one identical file. Differences remain in edit selectivity and patch outcomes, providing initial evidence that explicit artifact roles may influence maintenance behavior beyond localization alone. This pilot does not establish the general effectiveness of Boundary Contracts. Rather, it provides initial evidence for a broader research question: how should the operational boundaries of coding agents be generated, validated, revised, and ultimately enforced as repository-level maintenance becomes increasingly autonomous?
papers.translated_summary: 随着编码代理获得更大的自主权来修改软件仓库，仅凭相关上下文并不能界定其操作权限。某个工件可能与维护任务相关，却不适合被编辑；反过来，另一个工件可能即使请求中未明确提及，也是必需的。我们探索了边界契约（Boundary Contracts），这是一种机器可读的抽象，可在仓库修改开始之前明确任务特定的工件角色（可编辑、仅检查、必需和受保护）。我们针对来自真实企业仓库的40个维护任务开展了一项试点研究，将同一个基于Codex的编码代理在有和没有边界契约信息的情况下进行比较。有边界信息的条件将宏编辑选择F1从0.440提升至0.682，必需行为覆盖率从0.429提升至0.673，严格可接受补丁的数量从40个中的9个提升至40个中的18个。为探究这些增益是否仅由文件定位改善所解释，我们额外分析了21个任务，在这些任务中两种条件都至少修改了一个相同的文件。编辑选择性和补丁结果方面仍存在差异，这提供了初步证据，表明明确的工件角色可能影响维护行为，而不仅仅是定位。本试点并未确立边界契约的普遍有效性。相反，它为一个更广泛的研究问题提供了初步证据：随着仓库级维护变得越来越自主，编码代理的操作边界应如何生成、验证、修订并最终强制执行？

papers.title: Lymphangiogenesis is Critical for Healing and Survival in a Murine Model of Laryngotracheal Injury
papers.translated_title: 淋巴管生成对喉气管损伤小鼠模型的愈合和生存至关重要
papers.author: Gulleman, P.
papers.summary: Objective: Lymphatic dysfunction has been implicated in exacerbating fibrosis in numerous diseases, yet the role of the lymphatic system in laryngotracheal injury has not previously been explored. This study aims to evaluate lymphatic vascular remodeling in a murine model of laryngotracheal stenosis (LTS) and determine how pharmacologic blockade of lymphangiogenesis impacts airway healing after mucosal injury. Methods: LTS was induced in C57BL6 mice using an established chemomechanical injury model. Lymphatic density was quantified using LYVE-1 immunohistochemistry. Mice were treated with the VEGFR-3-selective tyrosine kinase inhibitor SAR131675 to block lymphangiogenesis after injury. Outcomes assessed included survival, histopathology, immunohistochemistry, and Evans blue dye vascular leakage. Results: Laryngotracheal injury induced a substantial increase in subepithelial lymphatic vessel density concomitant with fibrotic remodeling. Pharmacologic inhibition of VEGFR-3 signaling with SAR131675 abrogated this lymphangiogenic response and resulted in markedly increased mortality, impaired epithelial repair with obstructive sloughing, increased edema, and persistent histopathologic evidence of tissue injury. A qualitative increase in pathologic fibrocellular remodeling was also observed, though with no measurable difference in lamina propria thickness. Conclusion: These findings establish lymphatic remodeling as an essential component of successful airway repair following mucosal injury. Lymphatic dysfunction is a common feature of known risk factors for LTS including diabetes, obesity, and prematurity, and can be exacerbated by positive pressure ventilation. Disruption of the lymphangiogenic response to airway injury may lead to stasis of pro-inflammatory factors that result in chronic inflammation, maladaptive remodeling, and pathologic tissue changes. The lymphatic vasculature is a viable target for future mechanistic study and potential therapeutic intervention following airway injury.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：淋巴功能障碍已被认为会在多种疾病中加剧纤维化，但淋巴系统在喉气管损伤中的作用此前尚未被探讨。本研究旨在评估喉气管狭窄（LTS）小鼠模型中的淋巴血管重塑，并确定药物性阻断淋巴管生成如何影响黏膜损伤后的气道愈合。方法：采用已建立的化学机械损伤模型在C57BL6小鼠中诱导LTS。使用LYVE-1免疫组化定量淋巴管密度。小鼠在损伤后接受VEGFR-3选择性酪氨酸激酶抑制剂SAR131675治疗以阻断淋巴管生成。评估的结局包括生存率、组织病理学、免疫组化和Evans蓝染料血管渗漏。结果：喉气管损伤诱导上皮下淋巴管密度显著增加，并伴随纤维化重塑。使用SAR131675对VEGFR-3信号进行药物性抑制消除了这种淋巴管生成反应，并导致死亡率显著增加、上皮修复受损伴阻塞性脱落、水肿增加以及持续的组织损伤组织病理学证据。还观察到病理性纤维细胞重塑的定性增加，但固有层厚度无 measurable 差异。结论：这些发现确立了淋巴重塑是黏膜损伤后成功气道修复的重要组成部分。淋巴功能障碍是LTS已知危险因素（包括糖尿病、肥胖和早产）的共同特征，并可被正压通气加重。对气道损伤的淋巴管生成反应的破坏可能导致促炎因子淤滞，从而引起慢性炎症、适应不良性重塑和病理性组织改变。淋巴血管系统是气道损伤后未来机制研究和潜在治疗干预的可行靶点。

papers.title: Head movement allocation in freely-moving macaques learning object-context sequences
papers.translated_title: 自由活动猕猴学习物体-情境序列时的头部运动分配
papers.author: Rahman, K. F.
papers.summary: Flexible learning and long-term memory are hallmark features of primate cognition that are shaped by interactions with changing environments. A comprehensive understanding of these brain-body-environment interactions requires minimal constraints on behavior, and environments rich with conditional cues that encourage diverse behavioral dynamics. In this study, we introduce a multi-level enclosure (Treehouse) that allows for independent control of spatially distributed touchscreens for studying cognition in freely moving macaques. To test flexible learning, two monkeys completed trials consisting of a regular sequence of conditional object choices (targets) across four distinct spatiotemporal contexts (screens). Both monkeys acquired numerous unique, conditional object-context sequences without detriment to new learning as memoranda accumulated. They also successfully recalled their correct choices after weeks without exposure. To assess how monkeys allocate movement during learning and memory-guided decision making, we tracked their head kinematics and used recurrent neural networks to decode different aspects of their engagement with the environment during the choice epoch of the task. One such model predicted the position of the object about to be touched, including on error trials, tracking overt gaze towards objects. Separate models decoded sequence corner, the ordinal step, and the individual screen stations the monkeys occupied, despite identical stimulus layouts and behavioral demands at each station. Head movements also showed efficiencies that the task did not require: under conditions of uncertainty, monkeys were biased in their initial search locations to the targets that were closest to reach, and across days they made smoother head movements as training progressed, with no change in accuracy. These results demonstrate the potential of immersive 3-D environments, in which body kinematics can shed light on animals' goals, and reveal that situated learning in primates can be rapid, capacious, durable, and flexible.
papers.translated_summary: 灵活学习和长期记忆是灵长类认知的标志性特征，这些特征在与不断变化的环境互动中得以塑造。要全面理解这些大脑-身体-环境的交互作用，需要对行为施加最小约束，并需要充满条件性线索的环境以鼓励多样化的行为动态。在本研究中，我们引入了一种多层围栏（Treehouse），允许独立控制空间分布式的触摸屏，用于研究自由活动猕猴的认知。为测试灵活学习，两只猴子完成了由条件性物体选择（目标）的规则序列组成的试验，跨越四个不同的时空情境（屏幕）。两只猴子习得了大量独特的、条件性的物体-情境序列，且随着记忆项积累，新学习未受损害。它们还能在数周未接触后成功回忆起正确的选择。为评估猴子在学习和记忆引导决策过程中如何分配运动，我们追踪了其头部运动学，并使用循环神经网络解码其在任务选择阶段与环境互动的不同方面。其中一个模型预测了即将被触摸物体的位置，包括在错误试验中，追踪了对物体的外显注视。其他模型分别解码了序列角落、序数步骤以及猴子所处的各个屏幕站点，尽管每个站点的刺激布局和行为要求完全相同。头部运动还表现出任务并未要求的效率：在不确定条件下，猴子在初始搜索位置上偏向于距离最近的目标；且随着训练进展，跨天头部运动变得更加平滑，而准确性没有变化。这些结果展示了沉浸式三维环境的潜力——在其中身体运动学可以揭示动物的目标——并揭示了灵长类的情境化学习可以是快速的、容量大的、持久的和灵活的。

papers.title: A rational design strategy and validation for protease-resistant fusion-inhibitor antiviral peptides
papers.translated_title: 抗蛋白酶融合抑制抗病毒肽的理性设计策略与验证
papers.author: Yang, K.
papers.summary: Peptide-based fusion inhibitors are promising pharmaceuticals in the fight against enveloped viruses relying on membrane fusion for host infection. However, peptide therapeutic applications have long been hindered by their poor stability in vivo. Here, we discovered that peptide inhibitors with the wildtype sequence of the heptad repeat 2 (HR2) domain of the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein are efficiently cleaved by Transmembrane Protease, Serine 2 (TMPRSS2), a key protease involved in the SARS-CoV-2 virus-cell fusion pathway. We then identified the corresponding cleavage sites and designed three protease-resistant peptides using ranking based on deep mutational scanning and natural occurrence. The three candidates all exhibit inhibitory activity in a cell-cell fusion assay. A high-resolution cryo-EM structure of the top candidate, HR2-NHN, bound to its HR1 target reveals the molecular basis for its potent activity. The top candidate of the cell-based screening assay showed significantly improved efficacy relative to the wildtype peptide when administered at different times before infection in both an authentic virus-cell infection assay and a mouse assay. More broadly, our results suggest that the design strategies for protease-resistant peptides could be applied to a broad spectrum of other enveloped viruses and pave the way for the development of safe, prophylactic antivirals that can be administered before exposure.
papers.translated_summary: 基于肽的融合抑制剂是抗击依赖膜融合感染宿主的包膜病毒的有前景的药物。然而，肽类治疗应用长期以来受限于其在体内的稳定性较差。在此，我们发现，具有SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白七肽重复序列2（HR2）结构域野生型序列的肽抑制剂会被跨膜丝氨酸蛋白酶2（TMPRSS2）高效切割，后者是参与SARS-CoV-2病毒-细胞融合途径的关键蛋白酶。随后，我们鉴定了相应的切割位点，并基于深度突变扫描和自然发生的排序设计了三种抗蛋白酶肽。这三种候选肽在细胞-细胞融合实验中均表现出抑制活性。排名第一的候选肽HR2-NHN与其HR1靶标结合的高分辨率冷冻电镜结构揭示了其强效活性的分子基础。在真实病毒-细胞感染实验和小鼠实验中，当在感染前不同时间给药时，基于细胞的筛选实验中的排名第一候选肽相对于野生型肽显示出显著改善的效力。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，抗蛋白酶肽的设计策略可应用于广泛的其它包膜病毒，并为开发可在暴露前给药的安全预防性抗病毒药物铺平了道路。

papers.title: Regulatory plasticity of the rdar biofilm morphotype in clinical uropathogenic Escherichia coli and its modulation by ciprofloxacin
papers.translated_title: 临床尿路致病性大肠杆菌中rdar生物膜形态型的调控可塑性及其受环丙沙星的调节
papers.author: Mushtaq, F.
papers.summary: Background: Red, dry and rough (rdar) biofilm formation in Escherichia coli is characterized by the coordinated production of extracellular cellulose and amyloid curli fimbriae. Although rdar biofilm formation has been extensively characterized in laboratory strains, its clinical relevance and implications for antimicrobial treatment remain poorly understood. Methods: We screened 146 consecutive E. coli isolates from patients with urinary tract infections in Lahore, Pakistan (2017-2019) for Congo red morphotypes at 28 degrees C and 37 degrees C. Antimicrobial susceptibility was determined by disc diffusion and compared between morphotypes using the Fisher exact test. Fourteen isolates were whole-genome sequenced, the csgD-csgBA intergenic region was aligned, and csgD expression was quantified by qRT-PCR. The effect of 10 micrograms/mL ciprofloxacin on rdar morphotype expression, matrix ultrastructure and biofilm formation was examined in ciprofloxacin-resistant isolates (MIC at least 128 micrograms/mL). Results: Rdar-like colony morphotypes were expressed by 36.3% (53/146) of isolates at 28 degrees C and 29.5% (43/146) at 37 degrees C. Nucleotide polymorphisms in the csgD-csgBA intergenic region clustered within annotated OmpR, IHF and CsgD binding regions and were associated with, but did not individually predict, the mode of rdar morphotype expression. Isolates carrying the rdar morphotype were distributed across diverse E. coli phylogroups and sequence types. Resistance to aztreonam, cefuroxime and cephradine was more frequent among smooth and white isolates, whereas resistance to nitrofurantoin was more frequent among isolates rdar-positive at 28 degrees C (45.2% versus 20.2%, p = 0.0097); fluoroquinolone resistance did not differ between morphotypes. Subinhibitory ciprofloxacin (10 micrograms/mL) suppressed rdar biofilm formation, disrupted extracellular matrix architecture and abolished surface colonization on glass, in ciprofloxacin-resistant isolates. Conclusions: Our findings establish the rdar morphotype as a clinically relevant biofilm phenotype in uropathogenic E. coli and show that subinhibitory ciprofloxacin suppresses rdar biofilm formation in ciprofloxacin-resistant isolates. These results underscore the importance of considering antibiotic-mediated modulation of biofilm behavior when interpreting treatment responses and designing strategies to combat persistent urinary tract infections.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：大肠埃希菌中红色、干燥和粗糙（rdar）生物膜形成的特征在于细胞外纤维素和淀粉样卷曲菌毛的协同产生。尽管rdar生物膜形成已在实验室菌株中得到广泛表征，但其临床相关性及对抗菌治疗的意义仍知之甚少。方法：我们筛查了巴基斯坦拉合尔尿路感染患者中连续分离的146株大肠埃希菌（2017—2019年），在28摄氏度和37摄氏度下检测刚果红形态型。采用纸片扩散法测定抗菌药物敏感性，并使用Fisher精确检验比较不同形态型之间的差异。对14株分离株进行全基因组测序，比对csgD-csgBA基因间区，并通过qRT-PCR定量csgD表达。在环丙沙星耐药分离株（MIC至少128微克/毫升）中，检测10微克/毫升环丙沙星对rdar形态型表达、基质超微结构和生物膜形成的影响。结果：在28摄氏度下，36.3%（53/146）的分离株表达rdar样菌落形态型；在37摄氏度下为29.5%（43/146）。csgD-csgBA基因间区的核苷酸多态性聚集于注释的OmpR、IHF和CsgD结合区域内，并与rdar形态型表达模式相关，但不能单独预测该模式。携带rdar形态型的分离株分布于不同的大肠埃希菌系统发育群和序列型中。对氨曲南、头孢呋辛和头孢拉定的耐药在光滑型和白色分离株中更常见，而对呋喃妥因的耐药在28摄氏度下rdar阳性分离株中更常见（45.2%对20.2%，p=0.0097）；氟喹诺酮类耐药在不同形态型之间无差异。在环丙沙星耐药分离株中，亚抑菌浓度环丙沙星（10微克/毫升）抑制rdar生物膜形成，破坏细胞外基质结构，并消除玻璃表面的定植。结论：我们的研究结果确立rdar形态型是尿路致病性大肠埃希菌中具有临床相关性的生物膜表型，并表明亚抑菌浓度环丙沙星可抑制环丙沙星耐药分离株中的rdar生物膜形成。这些结果强调，在解释治疗反应和设计对抗持续性尿路感染的策略时，考虑抗生素介导的生物膜行为调节具有重要意义。

papers.title: Naked antisense oligonucleotides access the cytosol during early endocytic trafficking
papers.translated_title: 裸反义寡核苷酸在早期内吞运输过程中进入细胞质。
papers.author: Sitarska, E.
papers.summary: Phosphorothioate-modified antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) enter cells, but their site of productive escape remains uncertain. We combined live-cell imaging and ratiometric pH measurements to follow a Malat1-targeting ASO internalized without a delivery vehicle. In U2OS cells, less than 4% of internalized ASO reached the nucleus under conditions that reduced Malat1 RNA by >90%. Most ASO accumulated in late endosomes, endolysosomes and lysosomes as foci and broadly distributed luminal signal. These compartments underwent neutralization without detectable membrane rupture or galectin-3 recruitment. ASO foci showed constrained motion, consistent with association with endolysosomal constituents. L-leucyl-L-leucine methyl ester-induced membrane damage or Calcium dependent lysosome exocytosis released dextran while retaining luminal ASO. Loss of the stress-granule scaffolding proteins G3BP1/2 modestly enhanced ASO activity without detectable endolysosomal damage. Tantalosin, a small molecule that perturbs endosomal recycling, redistributed the ESCRT-III protein IST1 to endosomes. It enhanced early escape of SYTOX Green and ASOs, detected by nuclear accumulation, and increased Malat1 knockdown, with cell-type-dependent responses. Tantalosin did not detectably increase nuclear ASO accumulation after sequestration in late compartments. These findings place productive ASO escape early in endocytic trafficking, most likely in early or recycling endosomes, before sequestration in largely nonproductive late compartments.
papers.translated_summary: 硫代磷酸修饰的反义寡核苷酸（ASOs）可进入细胞，但其有效逃逸位点仍不确定。我们结合活细胞成像与比率型pH测量，追踪了无需递送载体即可内化的靶向Malat1的ASO。在U2OS细胞中，在使Malat1 RNA减少超过90%的条件下，内化的ASO中不到4%到达细胞核。大多数ASO以灶状和广泛分布的腔内信号形式积累于晚期内体、内溶酶体和溶酶体中。这些区室发生了中和，但未检测到膜破裂或galectin-3募集。ASO灶表现出受限运动，与和内溶酶体组分结合相一致。L-亮氨酰-L-亮氨酸甲酯诱导的膜损伤或钙依赖性溶酶体胞吐释放了葡聚糖，但保留了腔内ASO。应激颗粒支架蛋白G3BP1/2的缺失适度增强了ASO活性，而未检测到内溶酶体损伤。Tantalosin是一种干扰内体循环的小分子，可将ESCRT-III蛋白IST1重新分布至内体。它促进了SYTOX Green和ASOs的早期逃逸，通过核积累检测到，并增加了Malat1敲低，且反应具有细胞类型依赖性。Tantalosin在ASO被隔离于晚期区室后并未可检测地增加核内ASO积累。这些发现表明，有效的ASO逃逸发生在内吞运输的早期，最可能是在早期或循环内体中，早于在基本无生产力的晚期区室中被隔离。

papers.title: Evolutionary Coupling of Flagellar Motility and Type VI Secretion Systems Across Bacteria
papers.translated_title: 细菌中鞭毛运动与VI型分泌系统的进化耦合
papers.author: Philip, J. S.
papers.summary: Bacteria use both motility and antagonism to compete in spatially structured environments, but whether these traits evolve together across broad bacterial diversity remains unclear. We developed a spatial kin-competition model predicting that motility should couple robustly with contact-dependent weapons by increasing encounter rates with competitors, whereas coupling with diffusible weapons should be weaker and context-dependent. To examine the evolutionary hypotheses motivated by the model, we performed a comprehensive analysis of 11,365 bacterial genomes across the bacterial Tree of Life (ToL). By utilising large-scale homology-based searches, we annotated flagellar, T6SS, and bacteriocin components and then applied phylogenetic comparative models to examine evolutionary associations. T6SS presence was strongly associated with flagellar motility: T6SS-positive lineages were predominantly flagellated, and BayesTraits supported a dependent model of FliC and T6SS evolution. In contrast, bacteriocins did not show detectable evolutionary coupling with flagellar motility. Transition-rate analyses further indicated that T6SS gain was strongly biased towards motile bacterial lineages, even though T6SS loss was common overall. These results indicate different macroevolutionary associations of flagellar motility with T6SS and bacteriocins, consistent with the qualitative hypothesis motivated by our model.
papers.translated_summary: 细菌利用运动性和拮抗作用在空间结构环境中竞争，但这些性状是否在广泛的细菌多样性中协同演化仍不清楚。我们开发了一个空间亲缘竞争模型，预测运动性应通过增加与竞争者的相遇率而与接触依赖性武器稳健耦合，而与可扩散武器的耦合则应较弱且依赖情境。为检验该模型提出的演化假说，我们对细菌生命之树（ToL）中11365个细菌基因组进行了全面分析。利用大规模同源性搜索，我们注释了鞭毛、T6SS和细菌素组分，然后应用系统发育比较模型来检验演化关联。T6SS的存在与鞭毛运动性强烈相关：T6SS阳性谱系主要为有鞭毛的，BayesTraits支持FliC和T6SS演化的依赖模型。相比之下，细菌素未显示出与鞭毛运动性可检测的演化耦合。转移率分析进一步表明，T6SS获得强烈偏向于运动性细菌谱系，尽管T6SS丢失总体上很常见。这些结果表明鞭毛运动性与T6SS和细菌素具有不同的大演化关联，这与我们的模型所提出的定性假说一致。

papers.title: Convergent genome- and gene-level constraints shape repeated environmental adaptation in grasses

papers.summary: Grasses (Poaceae) dominate terrestrial ecosystems and sustain global food security, yet the genomic principles enabling their repeated adaptation to extreme environments remain unresolved. Combining dense phylogenomic sampling, global environmental data, and genomic large language models (gLLMs), we characterize the mutational targets underlying environmental shift across 687 genomes from 561 species spanning 17 climate zones. We identify 17-30 phylogenetically independent transitions into extreme temperature, water, and soil environments, accompanied by convergent shifts in genome-scale molecular properties, including the Nitrogen-to-Carbon balance and the biosynthetic cost of the proteome. Our gLLMs-informed phylogenetic mixed modeling framework identifies 330 genes that repeatedly associated with distinct axes of environmental variation, highlighting the importance of protein modification and localization within extracellular and organellar compartments. Overlaying independent convergent selection tests identifies 27 high-confidence candidates for further characterization. Together, our results show that grass adaptation is canalized by layered constraints at genome-wide and gene-specific scales, producing predictable evolutionary trajectories.
papers.translated_summary: 禾本科植物（Poaceae）主导陆地生态系统并支撑全球粮食安全，然而使其反复适应极端环境的基因组原理仍未得到解析。结合密集的系统发育基因组采样、全球环境数据和基因组大语言模型（gLLMs），我们刻画了跨越17个气候带、561个物种的687个基因组中环境转变所对应的突变靶点。我们识别出17至30次系统发育上独立的向极端温度、水分和土壤环境的转变，并伴随基因组尺度分子特性的趋同变化，包括氮碳平衡和蛋白质组的生物合成成本。我们的gLLMs信息驱动的系统发育混合建模框架识别出330个反复与不同环境变异轴相关的基因，突显了蛋白质修饰及其在胞外和细胞器区室中定位的重要性。叠加独立的趋同选择检验，我们识别出27个高置信度候选基因以供进一步表征。总之，我们的结果表明，禾本科植物的适应受到全基因组和基因特异性尺度上多层次约束的渠化，产生可预测的演化轨迹。

papers.title: Artificial Reactivation of a Cocaine-Associated Ensembles in the Dorsal Dentate Gyrus Attenuates Cocaine Prime-Induced Reinstatement of Drug-Seeking

papers.summary: Relapse-prevention strategies aimed at reducing relapse following abstinence primarily focus on reducing cravings that lead to drug-seeking triggered by stress, drug-related cues, or re-exposure to the drug. Because addictive drugs form persistent associative contextual memories, we investigated how reactivation of cocaine-related hippocampal memories influences subsequent drug-seeking. Here, we tagged dorsal dentate gyrus (dDG) memory ensembles involved in encoding either a first or fourth cocaine exposure (15mg/kg, i.p) in male and female c57BL/6 mice using a TetTag approach. Mice underwent cocaine conditioned place preference (CPP), extinction, and reinstatement. We assessed whether optical reactivation of tagged cocaine-related ensembles could substitute for a cocaine priming injection to reinstate CPP, whether reactivation altered cocaine-induced reinstatement, and if these effects differed depending on stage of drug exposure. We also compared these effects to reactivation of saline-associated ensembles. Cocaine produced robust locomotor activation during conditioning and sensitization developed across repeated drug exposures. Reactivation of a cocaine-related engram alone did not reinstate CPP. However, reactivation of the first cocaine exposure engram attenuated cocaine-induced reinstatement. In contrast, reactivation of the fourth exposure engram did not confer this protective effect. Interestingly, reactivation of saline-associated ensembles also reduced cocaine-induced reinstatement specifically in females, suggesting dDG ensemble reactivation may modulate relapse-related behavior through interference or neuromodulatory disruption of cocaine-associated representations, consistent with our prior work. These findings raise the possibility that early contextual experiences form competing or destabilizing representations that interfere with later cocaine-seeking when reactivated. Females also displayed greater sensitivity to locomotor-inducing effects of cocaine memory reactivation, although this was dissociated from CPP. Together, these findings show that cocaine memories are distinct across drug experience and selective reactivation of dDG engrams can differentially influence drug-seeking.
papers.translated_summary: 旨在减少戒断后复吸的预防策略主要集中于降低由应激、药物相关线索或再次暴露于药物所触发的、导致觅药行为的渴求。由于成瘾性药物会形成持久的关联性情境记忆，我们研究了 cocaine 相关海马记忆的再激活如何影响随后的觅药行为。在此，我们使用 TetTag 方法在雄性和雌性 c57BL/6 小鼠中标记了背侧齿状回（dDG）记忆集合，这些集合参与编码首次或第四次 cocaine 暴露（15mg/kg，腹腔注射）。小鼠接受了 cocaine 条件位置偏好（CPP）、消退和复吸实验。我们评估了标记的 cocaine 相关集合的光学再激活是否可以替代 cocaine 启动注射以恢复 CPP，再激活是否改变 cocaine 诱导的复吸，以及这些效应是否因药物暴露阶段而异。我们还将这些效应与生理盐水相关集合的再激活进行了比较。Cocaine 在条件化过程中产生了强烈的运动激活，并且在反复药物暴露中发展出敏化。仅再激活 cocaine 相关印迹并不能恢复 CPP。然而，再激活首次 cocaine 暴露印迹减弱了 cocaine 诱导的复吸。相比之下，再激活第四次暴露印迹并未赋予这种保护效应。有趣的是，再激活生理盐水相关集合也减少了 cocaine 诱导的复吸，且仅在雌性中如此，这表明 dDG 集合再激活可能通过干扰或神经调质性破坏 cocaine 相关表征来调节复吸相关行为，这与我们先前的工作一致。这些发现提出了一种可能性，即早期情境体验形成了竞争性或去稳定化的表征，当被再激活时会干扰后来的觅药行为。雌性还表现出对 cocaine 记忆再激活的运动诱导效应更大的敏感性，尽管这与 CPP 相分离。总之，这些发现表明 cocaine 记忆在不同药物体验中具有差异性，并且 dDG 印迹的选择性再激活可以差异性地影响觅药行为。

papers.title: SMARTFlexDB: a paired apo-holo RNA structure database and analysis platform for RNA conformational flexibility and small-molecule recognition
papers.translated_title: SMARTFlexDB：一个配对apo-holo RNA结构数据库及分析平台，用于RNA构象灵活性和小分子识别
papers.author: Jiang, S.
papers.summary: RNA structures can undergo substantial conformational changes upon small-molecule binding, yet existing structural resources provide only static RNA-ligand snapshots without connecting ligand-bound (holo) RNA structures to corresponding ligand-free (apo) conformations. SMARTFlexDB is a curated database and analysis platform that uses paired apo-holo RNA structures to characterize conformational differences and RNA-small molecule recognition. Candidate pairs were identified from the Protein Data Bank by matching RNA chains with at least 90% sequence identity and coverage, and fully conserved binding pocket nucleotides. The current release contains 434 binding pockets from 266 holo structures, linked to 186 apo structures to yield 1187 pocket-level apo-holo pairs organized into 734 database entries, spanning 150 small molecules and 23 RNA functional classes. Each entry integrates RNA sequence and secondary-structure annotations, apo and holo three-dimensional structures, RNA-ligand atomic interactions, and quantitative descriptors of global and local conformational changes. An interactive web interface enables users to explore sequence alignments and structural overlays, compare secondary structures and RNA motifs, and upload paired apo-holo structures for customized analysis. By linking ligand-bound and ligand-free RNA structures, SMARTFlexDB provides a robust foundation for investigating RNA structural flexibility and supporting RNA-targeted small-molecule drug discovery. The database and analysis platform are available at https://aidd.rc.ufl.edu/app/smartflexdb/.
papers.translated_summary: RNA结构在小分子结合后可发生显著的构象变化，然而现有结构资源仅提供静态的RNA-配体快照，未将配体结合态（holo）RNA结构与相应的无配体（apo）构象关联起来。SMARTFlexDB是一个经过整理的数据库与分析平台，利用配对的apo-holo RNA结构来表征构象差异及RNA-小分子识别。候选配对通过匹配序列一致性和覆盖率至少90%且结合口袋核苷酸完全保守的RNA链，从蛋白质数据库中鉴定获得。当前版本包含来自266个holo结构的434个结合口袋，关联至186个apo结构，产生1187个口袋水平的apo-holo配对，组织为734条数据库条目，涵盖150种小分子和23个RNA功能类别。每条条目整合了RNA序列与二级结构注释、apo与holo三维结构、RNA-配体原子相互作用以及全局和局部构象变化的定量描述符。交互式网络界面使用户能够探索序列比对与结构叠加、比较二级结构和RNA基序，并上传配对的apo-holo结构进行定制分析。通过关联配体结合态与无配体RNA结构，SMARTFlexDB为研究RNA结构柔性及支持RNA靶向小分子药物发现提供了坚实基础。数据库与分析平台可在https://aidd.rc.ufl.edu/app/smartflexdb/获取。

papers.title: Identification of cis-Acting Elements that Regulate Influenza A Virus Segment 7 Differential mRNA Splicing
papers.translated_title: 鉴定调控甲型流感病毒第7节段差异mRNA剪接的顺式作用元件
papers.author: Zhou, S.
papers.summary: Influenza A virus segment 7 encodes the M1 matrix protein and M2 ion channel from an unspliced primary transcript (mRNA1) and spliced mRNA2, respectively. Both proteins are essential for efficient virus replication, but the intrinsic sequences that determine segment 7 splicing balance are not fully defined. Here, we systematically investigated how conserved cis-acting splicing elements regulate segment splicing. We found that while the splice acceptor sequence is optimal, both potential upstream polypyrimidine tracts regulate splicing, with the 5' region acting positively and the 3' region negatively to maintain M1 expression. Nucleotide A713 is the most likely mRNA2 branch point, but potentially with redundancy from other local adenosines. Mutagenesis of the mRNA2 splice donor sequence showed that it is nearly optimal but that nucleotides 51 and 55 modestly downregulate splicing efficiency. Most introduced mutations that change splicing balance are nonsynonymous in M1. Nevertheless, polypyrimidine tract and branch point mutations that significantly perturbed M1:M2 balance resulted in viable viruses. In contrast, the splice donor sequence was largely intolerant of mutation. We conclude that M1:M2 balance is maintained via suboptimal splice donor and polypyrimidine tract splicing signals, with the latter allowing more evolutionary flexibility to vary the ratio and/or M1 sequence

papers.title: Concordance with the MIND diet is associated with lower subsequent epigenetic aging
papers.translated_title: 与MIND饮食的一致性程度较高与后续表观遗传衰老程度较低相关

papers.summary: Healthy dietary patterns may influence biological aging, but prospective evidence for the MediterraneanDASH Intervention for Neurodegenerative Delay (MIND) diet is limited. We linked 2013 dietary data to 2016 DNA methylation measures in 1,740 Health and Retirement Study participants. Per 1-s.d. higher MIND score, adjusted differences were -0.4 years for PhenoAge acceleration (95% CI -0.8 to -0.1), -0.3 years for GrimAge acceleration (-0.5 to -0.1) and -0.0054 for methylation Pace of Aging (-0.0098 to -0.0010); all false-discovery-rate q[≤]0.026. Associations persisted after body-mass-index adjustment and selection weighting. Targeted maximum likelihood estimates were concordant with the conventional models, whereas causal forests evaluated in held-out and repeated-split samples found no reproducible evidence that specific subgroups of participants benefited more than others. Greater MIND adherence was associated with lower subsequent epigenetic aging across complementary measures, supporting molecular aging as an intermediate phenotype for diet-aging research.

papers.title: Comparative effectiveness of digital health interventions for low back pain: systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials
papers.translated_title: 数字健康干预对下背痛比较效果：随机对照试验的系统评价与网络荟萃分析
papers.author: Chen, R.
papers.summary: Objective To determine the comparative effectiveness of different digital health interventions for adults with low back pain. Design Systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials. Data sources PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), CINAHL, APA PsycINFO, ClinicalTrials.gov, and the World Health Organization International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (WHO ICTRP), from inception to 19 March 2026 (updated to 8 August 2026). Study selection Randomised controlled trials enrolling adults with low back pain. Interventions were classified as telemedicine, web-based applications (Web-App), mobile applications (Mobile-App), virtual reality (VR), exergaming, biofeedback devices, face-to-face care, and control. Paired reviewers independently screened records, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool. Methods Frequentist random-effects network meta-analyses synthesised pain intensity and physical function (primary outcomes), and pain-related fear avoidance, health-related quality of life, self-efficacy, anxiety, and depression (secondary outcomes), assessed at post-intervention (from the end of treatment to < 2 months post-intervention), short-term ([≥]2 to <6 months), mid-term ([≥]6 to <12 months), and long-term ([≥]12 months) follow-up. Effects were reported as standardised mean differences with 95% confidence intervals. Transitivity was examined across potential effect modifiers, and Confidence in Network Meta-Analysis (CINeMA) informed confidence ratings. Results Ninety-two reports representing 84 trials involving 11 649 participants were included. At post-intervention, compared with control, VR showed the largest estimated reduction in pain intensity (SMD -1.43, 95% CI -1.87 to -0.98; moderate confidence) and improvement in physical function (-0.86, -1.45 to -0.26; very low confidence). VR was also associated with lower pain-related fear avoidance (-1.14, -1.68 to -0.61) and better health-related quality of life (0.97, 0.57 to 1.36) (both moderate confidence). Exergaming, Mobile-App, Web-App and telemedicine were also associated with lower pain intensity, while Mobile-App, Web-App, telemedicine, and biofeedback devices were associated with better physical function. For self-efficacy, exergaming (0.77, 0.05 to 1.49) showed favourable post-intervention effects, although confidence in this estimate was very low. No intervention showed a clear effect on anxiety, with confidence ranging from very low to moderate across comparisons, whereas telemedicine was associated with lower depression (-0.22, -0.44 to 0.00; low confidence). Networks became progressively sparse at later follow-up, and evidence of sustained effects was inconsistent across interventions and outcomes. Global inconsistency was detected in the post-intervention pain-intensity network, with local inconsistency identified for selected exergaming comparisons, and substantial heterogeneity was present in several networks. Conclusions Among adults with low back pain, VR showed the largest estimated post-intervention effects versus control for pain intensity, physical function, pain-related fear avoidance, and health-related quality of life, although comparative effects differed across outcomes. Self-efficacy showed favourable estimates for selected interventions, whereas evidence for anxiety and depression was limited. Evidence beyond treatment completion was increasingly sparse, and confidence in many network estimates was low or very low; firm comparative recommendations therefore remain premature. papers.translated_summary: 目的 确定不同数字健康干预对成人下背痛的比较有效性。设计 随机对照试验的系统评价与网络荟萃分析。数据来源 PubMed、Embase、Cochrane对照试验中心注册库（CENTRAL）、CINAHL、APA PsycINFO、ClinicalTrials.gov以及世界卫生组织国际临床试验注册平台（WHO ICTRP），检索时间自建库至2026年3月19日（更新至2026年8月8日）。研究选择 纳入成人下背痛患者的随机对照试验。干预措施分类为远程医疗、基于网络的应用程序（Web-App）、移动应用程序（Mobile-App）、虚拟现实（VR）、体感游戏、生物反馈设备、面对面照护和对照。由两名评价者独立筛选记录、提取数据，并使用Cochrane偏倚风险2工具评估偏倚风险。方法 采用频率学派随机效应网络荟萃分析，综合疼痛强度和躯体功能（主要结局），以及疼痛相关恐惧回避、健康相关生活质量、自我效能、焦虑和抑郁（次要结局），评估时间点为干预后（从治疗结束至干预后<2个月）、短期（≥2至<6个月）、中期（≥6至<12个月）和长期（≥12个月）随访。效应以标准化均数差及95%置信区间报告。在潜在效应修饰因素间检验传递性，并采用网络荟萃分析置信度（CINeMA）进行置信度评级。结果 共纳入92篇报告，代表84项试验，涉及11 649名参与者。在干预后，与对照相比，VR在疼痛强度上显示出最大的估计降低效应（SMD -1.43，95% CI -1.87至-0.98；中等置信度），并在躯体功能上显示出改善（-0.86，-1.45至-0.26；极低置信度）。VR还与较低的疼痛相关恐惧回避（-1.14，-1.68至-0.61）和较好的健康相关生活质量（0.97，0.57至1.36）相关（两者均为中等置信度）。体感游戏、Mobile-App、Web-App和远程医疗也与较低的疼痛强度相关，而Mobile-App、Web-App、远程医疗和生物反馈设备与较好的躯体功能相关。对于自我效能，体感游戏（0.77，0.05至1.49）在干预后显示出有利效应，尽管该估计的置信度极低。没有干预措施对焦虑显示出明确效应，各比较的置信度从极低到中等不等，而远程医疗与较低的抑郁相关（-0.22，-0.44至0.00；低置信度）。网络在较晚随访时逐渐稀疏，持续效应的证据在不同干预和结局间不一致。在干预后疼痛强度网络中检测到全局不一致性，部分体感游戏比较存在局部不一致性，多个网络存在显著异质性。结论 在成人下背痛患者中，VR在干预后对疼痛强度、躯体功能、疼痛相关恐惧回避和健康相关生活质量方面相对于对照显示出最大的估计效应，但比较效应因结局而异。自我效能在部分干预中显示出有利估计，而焦虑和抑郁的证据有限。治疗完成之后的证据日益稀疏，许多网络估计的置信度为低或极低；因此，作出明确的比较性推荐仍为时过早。系统评价注册 PROSPERO CRD420261339841

papers.title: Exploring sex-dependent responses to anodal tDCS in subacute stroke rehabilitation: a post-hoc analysis of the randomized sham-controlled NETS Trial
papers.translated_title: 探索亚急性卒中康复中阳极经颅直流电刺激的性别依赖性反应：随机假对照NETS试验的事后分析
papers.author: Wolf, S.
papers.summary: Background Upper limb dysfunction is among the most disabling consequences of stroke, yet transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS), an extensively investigated adjunct to motor rehabilitation, has not demonstrated consistent benefit in large randomized trials. Interindividual variability may contribute, and sex is a plausible source given anatomical and neurophysiological differences relevant to tDCS. In this post-hoc, exploratory secondary analysis of the NETS trial, we examined sex as a potential effect modifier of tDCS response across the 90-day follow-up and all three domains of the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF). Longitudinal mixed-effects models with autoregressive correlation structures examined treatment-by-sex interactions for the Upper-Extremity-Fugl-Meyer Assessment (UEFMA; body function), Box-and-Block Test (BBT; activity), and Stroke Impact Scale participation domain (SIS; participation). Sensitivity analyses included per-protocol analysis, continuous-time models and three-way sex-by-treatment-by-time interactions. Women receiving active stimulation improved more than those receiving sham: estimated marginal mean differences: UEFMA 6.0 points (95%-CI 1.2;10.7), BBT 8.4 points (95%-CI 2.4;14.3), whereas no relevant treatment effect was observed in men. Results were similar in intention-to-treat and per-protocol populations. Conclusions This hypothesis-generating analysis suggests that sex may modify the response to tDCS in post-stroke upper limb rehabilitation. Together with similar subgroup signals from other trials, these findings warrant prospective, adequately powered trials with prespecified tests of treatment-by-sex interaction.

papers.title: Psychological inoculation protects young women in South Africa against HIV prevention misinformation: Evidence from a randomised controlled trial

papers.summary: BackgroundMisinformation decreases public confidence in health technologies and willingness to use them. Psychological inoculation, or "prebunking", exposes people to misleading claims before they spread widely and refutes the claims and embedded persuasion tactics. Evidence on its effectiveness for HIV-related misinformation, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa and among young women (a population highly vulnerable to HIV), is limited. MethodsWe conducted a randomised controlled trial (July to October 2025) among 2,163 women aged 18-29 years recruited online in South Africa. Participants were randomly assigned to view two short TikTok-style inoculation videos addressing common myths about an HIV vaccine, or attention-matched control videos on nutrition and diabetes. All participants then viewed multiple false claims presented as social media posts. The primary outcome was intention to receive an HIV vaccine if available (1-10 scale), assessed immediately post-intervention and at three-week follow-up. Secondary outcomes included likelihood of recommending the vaccine; and perceived credibility, emotional impact, and shareability of misinformation claims. We used linear regression models to estimate intervention effects. ResultsMisinformation exposure reduced vaccine intentions by 0.63 points in the control group, while intentions increased by 0.30 points in the intervention group. Controlling for covariates and baseline intentions, post-exposure vaccine intentions were 0.92 points higher in the intervention group (95% CI 0.78, 1.06; p<0.01), a 12% relative increase. Intervention participants were also more likely to recommend the vaccine (+0.74; 95% CI 0.61, 0.88; p<0.01). Inoculation reduced perceived credibility, emotional distress, and sharing intentions across all false claims. Effects persisted at three-week follow-up (vaccine intentions: +0.97; 95% CI 0.78, 1.17; p<0.01). ConclusionBrief, scalable psychological inoculation delivered via social-media-style videos protected young womens HIV vaccine intentions, with effects generalising to novel claims and persisting over three weeks. Prebunking campaigns may safeguard public confidence in other new HIV prevention technologies like lenacapavir.

papers.title: Integrative Multi-Omics Analysis of Molecular Associations and Biological Pathways Underlying Neurodevelopmental Conditions in a Twin Cohort
papers.translated_title: 双胞胎队列中神经发育状况相关分子关联与生物学通路的整合多组学分析
papers.author: Zhang, Y.
papers.summary: Neurodevelopmental conditions (NDCs) arise from complex genetic-environmental interactions, yet their molecular underpinnings remain incompletely defined. We applied an integrative multi-omics approach within a deeply phenotyped twin cohort to identify systemic molecular signatures and pathways associated with NDCs. Our study included 237 twins aged 8-28 years from the Roots of Autism and ADHD Twin Study in Sweden (RATSS), with one or more omics layers available per individual, including serum and cerebrospinal fluid proteomics, urine and fecal metabolomics, blood metallomics, and whole-genome sequencing in a subset of 14 monozygotic twin pairs. Using the DIABLO framework, we identified cross-omics features that distinguish individuals with and without NDCs. The identified features converged on enriched metabolic and immune-related pathways, including purine metabolism, lysine degradation, PI3K-Akt, and MAPK signaling. Several key molecules also showed differential abundance at the single-molecule level in generalized estimating equation (GEE) models. ADA protein, pyrimidine-related metabolites (thymidine, glutamine, and 2'-deoxyuridine), and copper showed suggestive associations within NDC-discordant MZ twin pairs, pointing to potential non-shared condition-related effects, while flavin mononucleotide and manganese associations with NDCs were influenced by shared genetic or familial environmental factors. Our findings indicate that NDC-related molecular alterations manifest across multiple biological layers and tissues, and are detectable through integrative systems-level analysis. Our scalable framework provides critical insights into altered metabolic and immune processes in NDCs and highlights candidate features that may inform future biomarker development and mechanistic research in precision psychiatry.

papers.title: Who infected the reported cases? Evidence from 678,482 COVID-19 cases with identified infector collected in routine surveillance in the Netherlands, 2020-2022.
papers.translated_title: 报告的病例是谁感染的？来自荷兰2020-2022年常规监测中收集的678,482例已确定感染者的COVID-19病例的证据。
papers.author: Backer, J. A.
papers.summary: Background During infectious disease outbreaks, characteristics of reported cases are routinely collected. These give information on becoming infected but not on infecting others. We assess whether linking infectees to infectors, together with their characteristics, can help understand transmission. Methods From the start of the COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands, reported cases were asked to identify their most probable infector in routine surveillance, enabling the linking of cases. We assess for the period 27 February 2020 - 11 April 2022 whether the infectees of these transmission pairs are representative of all reported cases, whether the transmission pairs yield verifiable estimates of epidemiological characteristics (here the serial interval), and whether they provide information on transmission that cannot be obtained otherwise. Results Of 8,003,008 reported cases, 678,482 (8.5%) could be linked to their most probable infector. These infectees were largely representative of the reported cases regarding age group, sex, and geographical location. The mean serial interval of 3.6 days (sd 3.4 days) from transmission pairs aligns with literature. Transmissions between age groups largely follow known contact patterns. Most transmissions in September 2021 occurred between persons who were not (fully) vaccinated, indicating the effectiveness of the vaccine, and relatively few between persons with different vaccination status, indicating assortative mixing in vaccination status. Conclusion Transmission pairs can be efficiently collected in routine surveillance, providing insight into disease transmission. The current post-pandemic period provides an excellent opportunity to adjust reporting systems for linking infectees to their most probable infector as preparation for future outbreaks.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 在传染病暴发期间，通常会收集报告病例的特征。这些信息提供了关于感染他人的情况，但不提供关于感染他人的信息。我们评估将感染者与其传染者联系起来，并结合其特征，是否有助于理解传播。方法 自荷兰COVID-19大流行开始以来，在常规监测中要求报告病例识别其最可能的传染者，从而使病例能够联系起来。我们评估2020年2月27日至2022年4月11日期间，这些传播对的感染者是否代表所有报告病例，传播对是否产生可验证的流行病学特征估计（此处为序列间隔），以及它们是否提供无法以其他方式获得的传播信息。结果 在8,003,008例报告病例中，678,482例（8.5%）可以联系到其最可能的传染者。这些感染者在年龄组、性别和地理位置方面在很大程度上代表报告病例。传播对的平均序列间隔为3.6天（标准差3.4天），与文献一致。年龄组之间的传播在很大程度上遵循已知接触模式。2021年9月的大多数传播发生在未（完全）接种疫苗的人之间，表明疫苗的有效性，而不同疫苗接种状态的人之间的传播相对较少，表明疫苗接种状态存在选型混合。结论 传播对可以在常规监测中高效收集，提供对疾病传播的洞察。当前大流行后时期提供了一个极好的机会，调整报告系统以将感染者与其最可能的传染者联系起来，为未来暴发做准备。

papers.title: Variantscape: Retrospective Study of Large Language Model-Based Extraction of Variant-Treatment-Cancer Associations from Published Oncology Abstracts
papers.translated_title: Variantscape：基于大型语言模型从已发表肿瘤学摘要中提取变异-治疗-癌症关联的回顾性研究
papers.author: Wosny, M.
papers.summary: Objectives: Precision oncology relies on accurate interpretation of tumour-detected gene variants, to guide personalised treatment decisions. However, interpretation of variants in context requires extensive information that is often buried within unstructured biomedical literature and obscured by inconsistent nomenclature, making manual retrieval labour-intensive and prone to omissions. In this study, our aim was to evaluate the potential of large language models to extract variant-treatment-cancer associations at scale from published abstracts. Design: We developed Variantscape, a large-scale, automated pipeline and open-access web tool. It integrates traditional natural language processing methods with state-of-the-art large language models to extract, standardise, and analyse co-associations between genetic variants, cancer types, and therapeutic interventions from published biomedical abstracts. Results: From over 3.7 million abstracts published between January 2014 and October 2026, 886,195 articles containing gene names were eligible for extraction. Among these, 37,895 (4.3%) mentioned a variant, cancer type, and therapeutic agent together, covering 11,985 unique variants across 197 cancer types and 547 therapeutic agents. LLM verification against the abstract text confirmed at least one association in 35,224 papers, giving a literature-derived graph of 10,571 nodes and 44,644 verified edges. Canonical alterations in well-studied cancers (e.g., BRAF V600E in melanoma) were strongly linked to established treatments, while several rare variants also emerged with high-confidence literature support. Conclusions: By applying large language models to biomedical literature, Variantscape enables scalable, context-aware extraction of trilateral variant-treatment-cancer relationships. This approach supports early evidence synthesis/hypothesis generation, highlights underrecognized or rare associations for MTB preparation, and offers a practical resource for accelerating discovery and supporting precision oncology research and translation.
papers.translated_summary: 目标：精准肿瘤学依赖于对肿瘤检测到的基因变异进行准确解读，以指导个性化治疗决策。然而，在具体语境中解读变异需要大量信息，而这些信息往往埋藏在非结构化的生物医学文献中，并因命名不一致而难以辨识，使得人工检索费时费力且容易遗漏。在本研究中，我们的目标是评估大语言模型从已发表摘要中大规模提取变异—治疗—癌症关联的潜力。设计：我们开发了Variantscape，一个大规模自动化流程和开放获取的网络工具。它整合了传统自然语言处理方法与先进的大语言模型，从已发表的生物医学摘要中提取、标准化并分析遗传变异、癌症类型和治疗干预之间的共现关联。结果：从2014年1月至2026年10月发表的超过370万篇摘要中，有886,195篇包含基因名称的文章符合提取条件。其中，37,895篇（4.3%）同时提及变异、癌症类型和治疗药物，覆盖197种癌症类型和547种治疗药物中的11,985个独特变异。大语言模型对照摘要文本进行验证，确认35,224篇论文中至少存在一个关联，形成包含10,571个节点和44,644条已验证边的文献衍生图谱。研究充分的癌症中的经典改变（如黑色素瘤中的BRAF V600E）与既定治疗强关联，同时若干罕见变异也出现了高置信度的文献支持。结论：通过将大语言模型应用于生物医学文献，Variantscape能够可扩展、语境感知地提取变异—治疗—癌症三元关系。该方法支持早期证据综合/假设生成，突出用于MTB准备的未被充分认识或罕见的关联，并为加速发现、支持精准肿瘤学研究和转化提供实用资源。

papers.title: TruBlk™ Shilajit Resin Improves Sexual Function in Men with Erectile Dysfunction: A Randomised, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Multicenter Trial
papers.translated_title: TruBlk™ 喜来芝树脂改善勃起功能障碍男性性功能：一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、多中心试验
papers.author: Yadav, D.
papers.summary: Erectile dysfunction and age-related testosterone decline are common and growing concerns among ageing men, yet current pharmacological options are constrained by tolerability, cost, and reluctance to start hormone-based therapy, leaving a real gap for safe, long-term alternatives. Shilajit, a resinous plant exudate long used in Ayurvedic medicine, is increasingly proposed to fill this gap with its bioactive constituents thought to confer adaptogenic, antioxidant, and androgen-modulating effects. However, clinical support for this use remains thin, with most existing trials small and conducted in healthy men rather than those with diagnosed erectile dysfunction. In this randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter trial (CTRI/2025/07/090919), 100 men aged 35-55 years with mild-to-moderate erectile dysfunction (IIEF erectile function domain score 11-25) and symptoms suggestive of androgen deficiency were enrolled across two sites. Participants received 250 mg twice daily of standardised TruBlk Shilajit resin or matched placebo for 90 days. Primary endpoints, as registered, were change from baseline in IIEF total and domain scores, total and free testosterone and cortisol, and Hypogonadism Impact of Symptoms Questionnaire (HIS-Q) domain scores. Secondary endpoints included nitric oxide, Fatigue Severity Scale (FSS), and Participant and Investigator Global Assessments. Semen parameters were assessed in a subset of participants. IIEF total score improved significantly more in the TruBlk group (+32.1% vs. +13.6%; d=0.67, p=0.005), with significant gains in four of the five domains, namely erectile function, orgasmic function, overall satisfaction, and intercourse satisfaction (d=0.52-0.61, p=0.011-0.044), while sexual desire showed a smaller, non-significant improvement (d=0.44, p=0.109). This was accompanied by significant increases in total testosterone (+46.1% vs. +10.0%; d=0.44, p=0.030) and free testosterone (+37.4% vs. +6.8%; d=0.41, p=0.048). HIS-Q symptom domains showed a similar pattern to IIEF, with Day 90 differences favouring TruBlk in three of five domains (sexual, energy, and sleep; d=-0.59 to -0.82, p<0.02), while cognition and mood showed smaller, non-significant differences (d=-0.46 to -0.49, p=0.06-0.10). Among secondary endpoints, fatigue fell substantially more with TruBlk than with placebo, with FSS scores decreasing by 51.8% vs. 27.4% from baseline, a large between-group effect at Day 90 (d=-1.13, p<0.0001). At Day 90, 56-58% of TruBlk participants were rated "Much" or "Very Much Improved" on global assessment, compared with 12-14% of placebo. Nitric oxide showed no significant between-group difference. In an exploratory semen-analysis subset (n=57), sperm concentration increased with TruBlk relative to placebo ({delta}=0.53, p<0.001), and in a subset of 40 participants assessed for motility, total motility ({delta}=0.63, p<0.001) and progressive motility (d=0.82, p=0.014) also improved. Ninety days of standardised TruBlk Shilajit resin improved erectile function and increased total and free testosterone in men with mild-to-moderate erectile dysfunction, with improvement in several hypogonadism-related symptom domains, reduced fatigue and, in an exploratory subset, improved sperm concentration and motility. These results support standardised Shilajit resin as a promising intervention for sexual dysfunction in a clinically diagnosed population, meriting further clinical evaluation.
papers.translated_summary: 勃起功能障碍和与年龄相关的睾酮下降是老年男性常见且日益受到关注的问题，然而当前的药物治疗选择受到耐受性、成本以及不愿启动激素治疗的制约，为安全、长期的替代方案留下了真实的空白。Shilajit是一种树脂状的植物渗出物，长期用于阿育吠陀医学，越来越多地被提出用于填补这一空白，其生物活性成分被认为具有适应原、抗氧化和雄激素调节作用。然而，支持这一用途的临床证据仍然薄弱，现有大多数试验规模较小，且是在健康男性而非确诊勃起功能障碍的男性中进行的。在这项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、多中心试验（CTRI/2025/07/090919）中，共在两个中心纳入100名年龄35-55岁、患有轻至中度勃起功能障碍（IIEF勃起功能域评分11-25）且伴有提示雄激素缺乏症状的男性。参与者接受标准化TruBlk Shilajit树脂250 mg每日两次或匹配安慰剂，持续90天。注册的主要终点为IIEF总分及各域评分、总睾酮和游离睾酮及皮质醇、以及性腺功能减退症状影响问卷（HIS-Q）各域评分较基线的变化。次要终点包括一氧化氮、疲劳严重程度量表（FSS）以及参与者和研究者总体评估。在部分参与者中评估了精液参数。TruBlk组的IIEF总分改善显著更大（+32.1% vs. +13.6%；d=0.67，p=0.005），五个域中有四个域显著改善，即勃起功能、性高潮功能、总体满意度和性交满意度（d=0.52-0.61，p=0.011-0.044），而性欲显示出较小且不显著的改善（d=0.44，p=0.109）。与此同时，总睾酮（+46.1% vs. +10.0%；d=0.44，p=0.030）和游离睾酮（+37.4% vs. +6.8%；d=0.41，p=0.048）显著升高。HIS-Q症状域显示出与IIEF相似的模式，第90天时五个域中有三个域（性、精力和睡眠；d=-0.59至-0.82，p<0.02）的差异有利于TruBlk，而认知和情绪显示出较小且不显著的差异（d=-0.46至-0.49，p=0.06-0.10）。在次要终点中，TruBlk组的疲劳下降幅度显著大于安慰剂组，FSS评分较基线下降51.8% vs. 27.4%，第90天时组间效应量大（d=-1.13，p<0.0001）。第90天时，56-58%的TruBlk参与者在总体评估中被评定为“明显改善”或“非常明显改善”，而安慰剂组为12-14%。一氧化氮未显示显著的组间差异。在探索性精液分析亚组（n=57）中，相对于安慰剂，TruBlk组的精子浓度增加（{delta}=0.53，p<0.001），在评估活动力的40名参与者亚组中，总活动力（{delta}=0.63，p<0.001）和前向活动力（d=0.82，p=0.014）也得到改善。90天的标准化TruBlk Shilajit树脂改善了轻至中度勃起功能障碍男性的勃起功能，并增加了总睾酮和游离睾酮，同时改善了若干性腺功能减退相关症状域，减轻了疲劳，并在探索性亚组中改善了精子浓度和活动力。这些结果支持标准化Shilajit树脂作为临床确诊人群中性功能障碍的一种有前景的干预措施，值得进一步的临床评估。

papers.title: Reduced POLD3 Expression Induces DNA Damage and Telomere Shortening in Colorectal Cancer Cells: A Potential Mediator of Colorectal Cancer Risk Variants
papers.translated_title: POLD3表达降低诱导结直肠癌细胞DNA损伤和端粒缩短：结直肠癌风险变异的潜在介质
papers.author: Clarkson, E.
papers.summary: DNA Polymerase Delta (Pol {delta}) acts in DNA synthesis and in DNA repair, both important factors in the proliferative nature, longevity, and mutability of cancer cells. The chromosomal region containing POLD3, the third subunit of Pol {delta}, has recently been identified by genome wide-association studies as containing single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) that increase the risk of colorectal cancer (CRC). To explore the effects of changing POLD3 levels that may underly these statistical associations in CRC, we first carried out survival analyses in the Cancer Genome Atlas colon adenocarcinoma cohort. Cox proportional hazards modelling showed higher POLD3 expression to be associated with moderately improved overall survival in the full cohort. This association with survival was clearest in the microsatellite stable (MSS) subgroup. In order to investigate the mechanisms by which lower POLD3 expression may be associated with poorer outcome, we generated CRC cell line models with reduced POLD3 expression levels. Knockdown of POLD3 resulted in reduced proliferative ability and stalling of the cell cycle in S phase, with some apoptosis of CRC cells. Importantly, POLD3 knockdown cells exhibited DNA damage, manifested by double-stranded breaks (DSBs), and upregulation of DSB repair pathways. Reduced POLD3 also correlated with shortened telomeres with disruption of, specifically, the ALT telomeric maintenance pathway. Taken together these observations suggest that lower POLD3 expression can increase genetic instability in CRC cells in the form of DSBs and shortened telomeres and that this might underly the functional effect of CRC risk SNPs in the POLD3 locus in 11q13.4.
papers.translated_summary: DNA聚合酶δ（Pol δ）参与DNA合成和DNA修复，这两个过程都是癌细胞增殖特性、永续性和突变性的重要因素。全基因组关联研究最近发现，包含Pol δ第三亚基POLD3的染色体区域存在增加结直肠癌（CRC）风险的单核苷酸多态性（SNPs）。为了探究改变POLD3水平可能作为这些统计学关联在CRC中的基础所产生的影响，我们首先在癌症基因组图谱结肠腺癌队列中进行了生存分析。Cox比例风险模型显示，较高的POLD3表达与整个队列中总生存期的适度改善相关。这种与生存期的关联在微卫星稳定（MSS）亚组中最为明显。为了研究较低POLD3表达可能与较差预后相关的机制，我们构建了POLD3表达水平降低的CRC细胞系模型。敲低POLD3导致增殖能力下降和细胞周期停滞于S期，并伴有部分CRC细胞凋亡。重要的是，POLD3敲低细胞表现出DNA损伤，表现为双链断裂（DSBs）和DSB修复通路的上调。POLD3降低还与端粒缩短相关，特别是ALT端粒维持通路受到破坏。综上所述，这些观察结果表明，较低的POLD3表达可以以DSBs和端粒缩短的形式增加CRC细胞的遗传不稳定性，这可能正是11q13.4位点POLD3基因座中CRC风险SNP功能效应的基础。
